Private fields 820 m NE: deer feed on field edges (fields are private).
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

plan: Drive: from Village of Tofino, about 82 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.39997, -125.13448, pull off on As83G (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 70 m N, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: deer, Aug, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2013 cutblock (right here) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 1-7, Region 1. Season: mule deer bucks Sept 10 to Dec 10 and more rows (synopsis page 21, 99%). 1 legal flag below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-22, closures 2026-10-16.
R1A-deer-drive-0003.recDirections: From Port Alberni, take Highway #4 toward Tofino/Ucluelet, and turn right on Central Lake Road; the turnoff to Robertson Creek Fish Hatchery & Upper Sproat Lake Campground). Set your odometer to zero and drive on Central Lake Road, at 7.2 kilometres, turn right onto Ash Main Forest Service Road, just past the Boot Lagoon Hatchery. At 13.8 kilometres turn left onto Ash 286/Browns Bay Dryland Sort, stay right at the fork at 14.6 kilometres. Lowry Lake Recreation Site is on the left at 24.1 kilometres. NOTE: Odometer reading may vary from one vehicle to another. Access to Lowry Lake Recreation Site is via privately managed roads. For information on road access and gate closures please check the following website before you travel: https://www.mosaicforests.com/access
R1A-deer-drive-0003.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 1-7: about 4,458 hunter days a year for mule deer and white tailed deer (2020 to 2024 mean), 1.76 days per square km, top third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.1 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
